newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese shares end higher, focus on PI, BES.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese shares end higher, focus on PI, BES.

text.p: 1740 GMT - Portuguese shares closed higher with activity dominated by pulp group Portucel Industrial, Banco Espirito Santo and mobile phone operator Telecel.
* Interest in Portucel was sparked by a buy recommendation and sector upgrade by Salomon Brothers, dealers said.
* BES shares hit a record high of 3,100 escudos after better-than-expected 1996 results.
* Telecel shares hit an all-time high of 12,700 escudos on optimism about the company's 1996 results, dealers said.
* Dealers said they expected a heavy presence of foreign investors in the market tomorrow and that share prices could rise further.
